response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(t.avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps, AVG(t.total_points - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total_points > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: results.laps is stored as TEXT and is cast to a number for averaging; NULL laps values are ignored by AVG.
Inner join between results and races; results rows without a matching race are dropped, and the average total is taken over all race names (before filtering).
